introHtml: Lidded coffee mugs keep drinks hot longer and prevent spills during commutes or busy workdays. Whether you choose vacuum-insulated stainless steel options like the 16 oz Corkcicle® Coffee Mug or ceramic styles with cork bases, adding a lid makes your promo item more functional. Ideal for corporate gifts, employee incentives, or trade show giveaways. Customize with your logo using screen printing or laser engraving for a polished look.
